text: 欧洲STOXX 600指数收涨0.51%，报655.16点，在美联储主席沃什的杰克逊霍尔全球央行年会首秀日持稳于655点附近，本周累计上涨0.15%。 欧元区STOXX 50指数收涨0.95%，报6485.67点，日内过半时间持稳于6475点附近，沃什讲话后扩大涨幅，本周累涨0.36%。 富时泛欧绩优300指数收涨0.53%，报2616.13点，本周累涨0.05%。
text_en: Europe's STOXX 600 index closed up 0.51% at 655.16 points, holding near 655 points on the day of Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech, up 0.15% on the week. The eurozone STOXX 50 index closed up 0.95% at 6485.67 points, holding near 6475 points for much of the session before extending gains after Warsh's remarks, up 0.36% on the week. The FTSEurofirst 300 index closed up 0.53% at 2616.13 points, up 0.05% on the week.
